# Costco Supplier Meeting Prep

## Executive Summary
Available fetched evidence supports only a narrow meeting-prep note: vendor routing and the warehouse value model. [claim_vendor_routing] [claim_member_value]

## Context for Meeting
Use the meeting to validate fit against Costco's member-value and selected-merchandise model. [claim_member_value]

## What We Know
- Costco publishes vendor contact paths for prospective suppliers. [claim_vendor_routing]
- Costco describes its warehouse model as focused on member value and selected merchandise. [claim_member_value]

## What We Do Not Know
- The fixture does not identify supplier category, buyer team, geography, timing, or category priorities.

## Supplier/Buyer Angle
Hypothesis to confirm: prepare a concise fit discussion around member value and vendor routing, then ask the buyer to validate category-specific criteria. [claim_vendor_routing] [claim_member_value]

## Questions to Ask
- Which buying office, product category, geography, and decision timeline should this brief cover? [claim_vendor_routing]

## Risks and Watchouts
- Treat category priorities, current strategy, and buyer preferences as not verified by this thin evidence set.

## Evidence Limitations
- Evidence is thin: 2 evidence claims across 2 source IDs.
- Treat supplier priorities, category fit, and timing as questions to confirm until more primary evidence is added.

- Costco vendor information (src_costco_vendor) https://example.com/costco-vendor
- Costco annual report (src_costco_10k) https://example.com/costco-10k
